text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 25-27 पर पाठ पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 25-27 par paath padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the lesson on pages 25–27 of your book, then answer.

steps.question: Why did the workers from a factory come to the village of Gopeshwar?

questionMeaning.hi: कारख़ाने के मज़दूर गोपेश्वर क्यों आए?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kaarkhaane ke mazdoor Gopeshwar kyon aaye?

options: to cut ash trees for railway sleepers
steps.answer: to cut ash trees for railway sleepers
steps.modelAnswer: The workers came to Gopeshwar to cut the ash trees. The wood was to be used to make sleepers for the railways.

modelMeaning.hi: मज़दूर गोपेश्वर में ऐश के पेड़ काटने आए थे। लकड़ी से रेल की पटरियों के स्लीपर बनने थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mazdoor Gopeshwar mein ash ke ped kaatne aaye the. Lakdi se rail ki patriyon ke sleeper banne the.

steps.question: What did the villagers decide when the axemen refused to return?

questionMeaning.hi: कुल्हाड़ी वाले नहीं लौटे तो गाँव वालों ने क्या तय किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kulhaadi waale nahi laute to gaanv waalon ne kya tay kiya?

options: They would not let the axes touch the trees.
steps.answer: They would not let the axes touch the trees.
steps.modelAnswer: The villagers decided that they would not let the axes touch the trees, no matter what happened. They would hug the trees.

modelMeaning.hi: गाँव वालों ने तय किया कि चाहे कुछ भी हो, वे कुल्हाड़ियों को पेड़ों तक नहीं पहुँचने देंगे। वे पेड़ों से लिपट जाएँगे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Gaanv waalon ne tay kiya ki chaahe kuchh bhi ho, woh kulhaadiyon ko pedon tak nahi pahunchne denge. Woh pedon se lipat jaayenge.

steps.question: What did the axemen do when the villagers hugged the trees and shouted ‘Chipko’?

questionMeaning.hi: जब गाँव वाले पेड़ों से लिपटे, तो कुल्हाड़ी वालों ने क्या किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Jab gaanv waale pedon se lipte, to kulhaadi waalon ne kya kiya?

options: They were frightened and ran away.
They joined the villagers for lunch.
steps.answer: They were frightened and ran away.
steps.modelAnswer: The axemen were frightened by the turn the situation had taken and ran away.

modelMeaning.hi: हालात देखकर कुल्हाड़ी वाले डर गए और भाग गए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Haalaat dekhkar kulhaadi waale dar gaye aur bhaag gaye.

steps.question: What did the villagers do when the contractors chose another forest?

questionMeaning.hi: ठेकेदारों ने दूसरा जंगल चुना तो गाँव वालों ने क्या किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Thekedaaron ne doosra jungle chuna to gaanv waalon ne kya kiya?

options: They marched there in a procession with drums and banners.
steps.answer: They marched there in a procession with drums and banners.
steps.modelAnswer: The whole village, men and women, old and young, marched in a procession with drums, trumpets and banners like ‘Chop me – not the tree’.

modelMeaning.hi: पूरा गाँव, आदमी-औरतें, बूढ़े-जवान, ढोल, तुरही और ‘मुझे काटो, पेड़ को नहीं’ जैसे बैनर लेकर जुलूस में गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Poora gaanv, aadmi-auratein, boodhe-jawaan, dhol, turhi aur ‘mujhe kaato, ped ko nahi’ jaise banner lekar juloos mein gaya.

steps.question: What is the work of ‘Dasohli Gram Swarajya Mandal’?

questionMeaning.hi: ‘दसोली ग्राम स्वराज्य मंडल’ का काम क्या है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: ‘Dasohli Gram Swarajya Mandal’ ka kaam kya hai?

steps.modelAnswer: The Dasohli Gram Swarajya Mandal works to regenerate (grow again) the degraded forests.

modelMeaning.hi: दसोली ग्राम स्वराज्य मंडल ख़राब हुए जंगलों को फिर से हरा-भरा करने का काम करता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Dasohli Gram Swarajya Mandal kharaab hue junglon ko phir se hara-bhara karne ka kaam karta hai.

steps.question: True or false? Trees were being saved by the contractors.
steps.modelAnswer: False. The contractors were destroying the forests.

modelMeaning.hi: गलत। ठेकेदार जंगल नष्ट कर रहे थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Galat. Thekedaar jungle nasht kar rahe the.

steps.question: True or false? In 1953, a group of people from a factory arrived at the village of Gopeshwar.

questionMeaning.hi: 1953 में कारख़ाने के लोग गोपेश्वर आए।
questionMeaning.hinglish: 1953 mein kaarkhaane ke log Gopeshwar aaye.

steps.question: True or false? ‘Chipko’ or ‘Hug the trees’ was a non-violent movement of the mountain people to save their trees.

questionMeaning.hi: चिपको पहाड़ी लोगों का पेड़ बचाने का अहिंसक आंदोलन था।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Chipko pahaadi logon ka ped bachaane ka ahinsak aandolan tha.

steps.question: True or false? Dasohli Gram Swarajya Mandal is an organisation to regenerate the degraded forests.

questionMeaning.hi: दसोली ग्राम स्वराज्य मंडल ख़राब जंगलों को फिर से उगाने वाली संस्था है।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dasohli Gram Swarajya Mandal kharaab junglon ko phir se ugaane waali sanstha hai.

steps.question: True or false? Chipko Movement proved very valuable in the conservation of forests.

questionMeaning.hi: चिपको आंदोलन जंगलों के संरक्षण में बहुत काम का साबित हुआ।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Chipko aandolan junglon ke sanrakshan mein bahut kaam ka saabit hua.
